Subject: Re: Incident on 2027-03-25 — request for credit eligibility & calculation

Hi all —

I’ve completed the eligibility check and attached the populated calculation workbook. Summary below so you don’t have to open the sheet immediately:

Summary of findings (concise):
- Measurement window: 2027-03-01 to 2027-03-31 (monthly).
- Incident window: 2027-03-25 02:00 — 06:30 UTC (4.5 hours).
- Contracted monthly availability: 99.95% (equivalent to 21.9 minutes of allowed downtime).
- Actual measured downtime (total for month including this incident and a separate unrelated 12-minute event): 276 minutes.

Per SLA section 4.2 credit bands:
- Downtime between 120 — 480 minutes => credit = 25% of monthly service fee (per term table).

Calculated credit:
- Monthly committed fee (SkyForge Dedicated pool): $48,000
- Credit = 25% * $48,000 = $12,000
- Proposed issuance: one credit note applied to next invoice cycle or as an invoice adjustment (your preference).

Notes/assumptions:
- I used the standard rounding approach (round to nearest dollar).
- The calculation excludes a 30-minute scheduled maintenance that was pre-notified (listed in the workbook).
- Karthik has validated the raw telemetry and confirmed the aggregated 276 minutes figure (see attached uptime-log-20270325.zip).

Requesting finance approval: Marissa / Connor, please confirm sign-off on the credit amount and confirm whether we should issue as a credit note (recommended) or invoice adjustment. Once approved, I will prepare the formal credit note and set expected issuance date (target: within 10 business days after approval).

Sam / Priya — please confirm whether SkyForge prefers a credit note applied to May invoice or a direct invoice adjustment so we can prepare paperwork accordingly.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Manager, Customer Billing Operations
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com

Thanks Vanessa — good, clear work. I approve the credit calculation as presented.

Decision and next steps:
- Approved credit amount: $12,000 (25% of monthly committed fee).
- Issue method: Credit note applied to the May 2027 invoice (SkyForge has confirmed preference for credit note).
- Credit note id: CN-2027-0411-SF (we will generate this in the billing system).
- Expected issuance: Credit note queued today; SkyForge will see it applied on the May invoice (statement after May 1).
- Accounting will post an adjustment to deferred revenue accordingly; finance has been cc’d on this thread.

Olga / Vanessa — please prepare the formal credit note PDF and include the following in the description field: "Downtime adjudication — incident 2027-03-25; per MA section 4.2." Also attach the signed MA reference (copy attached for customer).

Sam / Priya — we appreciate your patience. If you need a formal PDF earlier for reconciliation, we can send a draft credit note within 48 hours.
